action.goal: Is Knott deliberately concealing risk when he speaks of the Corbitt House and the former Macario tenants?

roll_visibility_superseded.why: contract 16.5 split the hidden tier in two. The old repo recorded `keeper` because that was the only hidden value it had; under it this roll's row was dropped whole and a turn whose only mechanic was a player-declared Psychology read drew no mechanics card at all. `concealed` keeps the row and drops every figure. The die is hidden in both, which is what this case was recorded to protect.
